title: LIMITED-TIME EVENT: #03 TRIALS FOR NAVIGATOR OPEN
lines: 01 LIMITED-TIME EVENT: #03 TRIALS FOR NAVIGATOR OPEN
EVENT DURATION: February 12, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 26, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Trials for Navigator event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing Trial Tasks to earn Trial EXP, and increasing the level of Path of Trials.
[Path of Trials] DURATION: February 12, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 29, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Path of Trials] MAIN REWARDS: MARTHE [Coral Coast] - Holiday HD49 for Ceylon, Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, etc.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DURATION: February 12, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) - February 26, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Pozëmka / Penance / Młynar / Lee
★★★★★: Aurora / Cement / Akafuyu / Whisperain / Harmonie / Melanite
Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting].
03 KERNEL LOCATING OPEN
DURATION: February 13, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7) - February 27, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the Kernel Locating, you can pick and lock-in two 6-star Operators and three 5-star Operators as the rated-up Operators for the current banner. Correspondingly, the redeemable Operators in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area] will be shifted into: A 6-star and a 5-star Operator of your choice from the rated-up Operators for the current banner.
All possible Operators:
★★★★★★(2%): Exusiai/ Angelina/ Bagpipe/ Shining/ Skadi/ Ch'en/ Hellagur/ Blaze/ Hoshiguma/ Suzuran/ Aak/ Eyjafjalla

★★★★★(8%): Silence/ Nightmare/ Leonhardt/ Ayerscarpe/ Asbestos/ Pramanix/ Mayer/ Tsukinogi/ Ptilopsis/ Nearl/ Chiave/ Beeswax/ Franka/ Blue Poison/ Liskarm/ Croissant/ FEater/ Reed/ Broca/ GreyThroat/ Hung/ Leizi/ Sesa/ Shamare
Note: The odds of getting a 6-star Operator due to accumulated rolls in the [Kernel Headhunting] before the shift WILL carry to the [Kernel Locating] banner.
